acs.text: A pull request touching foundation/github gets a github-config workflow run that executes only terraform fmt, validate and the static policy checks, with no cloud credentials and no OIDC role assumed (PO decision: keep ADR-0010)
acs.raw_artifact:
+ sed -n 1,20p .github/workflows/github-config.yml
# Static checks for the GitHub settings stack. It holds no cloud credential and no GitHub token
# beyond read access: only the owner plans and applies this stack, locally (ADR-0010).
# policies/check-workflow.sh fails the build if this file ever gains a credential, an OIDC
# permission or a plan or apply command.
name: github-config

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'foundation/github/**'
      - '.github/workflows/github-config.yml'
      - 'mise.toml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: github-config-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

37:      - run: mise run github:check
+ grep -n '"github:' -A8 mise.toml
+ grep -E 'tasks|run|depends|terraform|tflint|check'

36-description = "Terraform format check of the GitHub settings stack"
37-run = "terraform fmt -recursive -check -diff foundation/github"
39:[tasks."github:validate"]
41-run = [
42-  "terraform -chdir=foundation/github init -backend=false -input=false",

59-  "foundation/github/policies/test-check-workflow.sh",
62:[tasks."github:check"]
